subject: The secret truth about why this app exists
preview_text: Honestly, building this wouldn't mean anything without people like you. Let me explain why that's so important.
body_paragraphs: I was looking at the user numbers this morning. 800+ people. And for a second, I felt that weird indie dev pride. But then it hit me. That number is meaningless. It's just a number. What matters is you.

Honestly, building this app wouldn't mean a thing without people like you. Every scan, every moment of clarity, every time someone trusts their gut because of this tool—that's the real product. Not the code. It's the quiet relief of seeing a pattern finally laid bare. It's the courage to say 'this isn't right.' That's what I'm building for.

That's why the Pattern Detection feature is the heart of it. It's not just analyzing one text. It's connecting dots across weeks or months of conversations. It sees what you might have missed in the moment. It's the digital version of your best friend saying, 'Wait, remember when they also said this?'

Open the app right now. Go to your dashboard and look at your history. See the patterns your scanner has been quietly documenting. It's your story, written in red flags and green lights. P.S. The next time your gut whispers, listen. Then let the scanner shout.
